experiment: P3o-Q global nonnegative in-phase support-curve MFT-count screen
research_question: On fresh compound I/Q identities, does a whole-delay-window nonnegative in-phase support curve for candidate counts 1 through 8 improve ordinal MFT target-count estimation beyond the identical-capacity sparse-magnitude control?

prior_boundary.generator_basis: MFT is a sum of real-positive-amplitude shifts of one complex LFM reference, so positive in-phase inverse-filter support is a global count model constraint.
prior_boundary.P3oM_N_O_P: local magnitude peaks, adjacent geometry, post-hoc abstention and per-peak complex coherence are frozen negative routes; none is adjusted here.
prior_boundary.mechanism_change: C1 receives only deterministic full-window candidate-count support/residual curves; it does not alter sparse event locations or use a threshold, a true count, a true delay, a regime or power.

roles.development: all 33 identities per combination; read once after method freeze

front_end.shared_tokens: P3o-M frozen four-channel sparse magnitude tokens, 16 locations, unchanged
front_end.C1: for candidate counts k=1..8, append at token k the normalized residual complex energy after k largest nonnegative in-phase support samples, their cumulative positive energy fraction, kth normalized support and kth/top support ratio; other supplementary entries zero
front_end.support_domain: entire 751-sample inverse-delay window; no local-max threshold or peak-distance rule

models.ordinal_output: seven cumulative logits decoded to count 1 through 8

stop_rule: If any promotion gate fails, stop P3o-Q. Do not tune support curve values, support selection, peak rule, model width, loss, training schedule or selection on 1840M/1850M. Do not generate confirmation identities or attach an expert.
next_if_pass: Freeze code/checkpoints/normalizers; evaluate two untouched identity confirmations before considering a predicted-label-gated MFT-only attachment.
